tasks.title: Linux floating overlay with best-effort screen-capture exclusion
acceptance: overlay_guard.py session detection, ExclusionPlan and capability_report implemented and unit tested
floating_overlay.py renders live JSONL events and never steals focus
Behavioural auto-hide while a ScreenCast session is detected, with manual hide preserved
context-cli overlay launches the overlay without performing capture itself
Capability matrix documented honestly; no claim of universal invisibility

tasks.title: Structured accessibility-tree reading with token budget
acceptance: Helpers emit schema-1 JSON tree nodes with role, text, focused, bounds, image and protected fields
A11yTree::parse rejects schema mismatch and malformed JSON
Focused, tree, text and auto render modes are unit tested
Token budget bounds max_tokens, max_nodes, max_depth and max_chars and sets truncated
Protected nodes are skipped and their text is never rendered
image_regions returns image/graphic nodes largest first

tasks.title: Region OCR for image/graphic accessibility nodes
acceptance: extract_region_text crops with sips/magick/convert and never OCRs the whole screen as a fallback
extract_regions_text skips regions below min_pixels and caps at max_regions
Regions below the pixel threshold return an empty string, not an error
Results are cached by screenshot path and region in a bounded map
OCR stays opt-in and is never used when accessibility text is sufficient
Region OCR reports the ocr source badge

tasks.title: Configurable global shortcuts for every feature
acceptance: Twelve stable actions are defined and mapped to default accelerators
Accelerator::parse and display round-trip; duplicate accelerators and unknown actions are rejected
hotkeys list, hotkeys init and hotkeys print work; init refuses to overwrite without --force
hide_overlay hides the panel immediately and is remembered by the behavioural guard
Every shortcut is reachable from the UI without a keyboard
Out-of-focus globals are documented as requiring the desktop's own hotkey tool

tasks.title: Native Codex/ChatGPT device authorization
acceptance: Device flow uses only official HTTPS auth.openai.com endpoints with redirects disabled
Credentials are stored 0600 in ContextLens's own config dir, never the Codex CLI's files
Tokens and user codes are never logged; Debug redacts them
Polling is bounded by MAX_POLLS and response bodies by MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES
codex-login --native, codex-status --native and codex-logout --native --confirm work without the CLI
CLI-backed behaviour is unchanged when --native is absent
